description: This Java class defines a command called ModifyConfig used for modifying an actor's configuration within the Ditto framework. It includes fields, constructors, factory methods, and overrides for equality, hashing, and string representation.

classes.name: ModifyConfig
classes.description: A final class representing a command to modify an actor's configuration within the Ditto framework. It extends CommonCommand and encapsulates a JSON configuration object.

methods.name: ModifyConfig.of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of ModifyConfig with specified JSON configuration and headers.

methods.name: ModifyConfig.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ModifyConfig instance from a JSON object, extracting the 'config' field.

methods.name: ModifyConfig.setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new ModifyConfig instance with updated DittoHeaders.
